rows.label: Weekly Strategy
rows.help: On: press View on the dynasty hub for the Weekly Strategy screen, with focus players, the weekly coach goal and the gameplan focus (they give XP at each Advance). Off: no View button and no Weekly Strategy XP.

rows.label: Press Box
rows.help: On: in Scores / Schedules, press A on any game this week to Take this game and play or watch it. Off: the game's own menu there, and no games are taken for you. A game you already took stays this week.
